main_text.head: QUAESTIO:
An Sophistica sit pars integrans Logicae?
main_text.p: ARISTOTELES de Elenchis sophisticis & captiosis doctrinam appendicem suæ Logicæ esse voluit, eam autem docuit, non ut fiat fallaciæ & captiunculæ, sed ut vitentur, sicut medicinæ quædam non ad sanitatem, sed ad venena vitanda præparantur. Sed quidam ex Logica hanc doctrinam exterminant, hoc argumento moti: Logica est ratio bene differendi. Sophistica non est ratio bene differendi. Ergo Sophistica non est pars Logicæ. Resp. Totum hunc syllogismum concedo. At ex eo non sequitur: in Logica non docendam rationem refutandi conclusiones sophisticas. Aliud enim est ipsa sophistica: aliud ratio solvendi detegendique sophismata: sicut aliud est mendacium, & aliud ratio deprehendendi mendacium. Statuo igitur modum, quo rationi male differendi occurritur, id est, ratione solvendi παραλογισμός [?], id est, fallaces & decipientes ratiocinationes, esse Logicam. At instas: Sophisticis elenchis & vitiosis syllogismis in vera artis descriptio.

page.notes: The woodcut initial A is joined to the word: "ARISTOTELES". Greek word after "solvendi" is at a line break and is read with doubt; the final letters are marked [?]. Printed "deprehendedi" is read as "deprehendendi" on the scan; the printed form is kept as seen. Ornament above the heading is not transcribed. No running head on this page, as it opens a division.
